Business-directory records list the branch under its clothing retail category, reflecting the Woolworths format that combines clothing with its wider range of grocery and general merchandise under one roof.

The Mankweng branch gives local shoppers a Woolworths outlet without needing to travel into central Polokwane, serving residents of Mankweng and the surrounding Ga-Thoka and Turfloop area who shop there for clothing and everyday Woolworths retail. It sits within Paledi Mall alongside the centre's other shops, making it a convenient stop for shoppers already visiting the mall for their regular shopping.

As part of the wider Spur network, the restaurant follows the brand's family-orientated approach, with a menu and setting designed to welcome children as well as adults.

Trading from within the Seshego Circle shopping centre, the branch sits among the centre's mix of retail stores, making it a convenient stop for customers already shopping in the area. Legends Barbershop Polokwane Central is a barbershop offering men's grooming services, including haircuts, beard trims, head shaves and general hair styling. Its services are built entirely around men's grooming rather than a broader unisex salon offering, and appointments can be booked online in advance through a booking platform, rather than relying only on walk-in customers arriving on the day.

The barbershop operates from 51 Market Street in Polokwane Central, within easy reach of other businesses in the central business district. It serves men in and around Polokwane Central looking for a straightforward barbering service, from a regular haircut and beard trim to a full head shave.

Lempitse Lodge is a three-star graded lodge in Makotse Village, Lebowakgomo, which opened in 2018 and says it aims for quality and high international standards. Its family rooms have air-conditioning, balconies, garden views, a kitchenette and a private bathroom. Guests can use an indoor swimming pool, a sun terrace, a lounge with an outdoor fireplace and a children's playground, and a family-friendly restaurant serves American, local, European and South African dishes, with a coffee shop and barbecue facilities on site.

Breakfast options are offered, free private parking is provided, and children of any age are welcome, although pets are not allowed. The lodge is next to Zone F, about 45 km from Polokwane, so it suits families and travellers who want a comfortable, self-contained stay in the Lebowakgomo area rather than in the city.

It operates independently rather than as part of a larger supermarket or retail chain, giving Mankweng a dedicated, standalone pharmacy option.

The pharmacy trades from the Cross Road Centre, near the Sasol Paledi filling station at the corner of the R71 and University Road in Mankweng, within reach of the University of Limpopo and the surrounding Ga-Thoka community. It serves local residents, students and staff who need a nearby pharmacy for everyday health and wellbeing needs, without having to travel further into Polokwane.

The store trades from Shop L49 in Mall of the North, placing it among the centre's other fashion and footwear retailers in Bendor Park. It serves shoppers in Bendor and the wider Polokwane area who are specifically looking for Skechers footwear rather than a general multi-brand shoe shop, giving them a dedicated brand outlet without having to shop online or travel to another city.

Spar Flora Park is a grocery store and supermarket in Flora Park, trading as a food-products supplier and a fruit-and-vegetable store for the surrounding neighbourhood. Listings for the branch show a notable level of ongoing customer activity, pointing to a shop that locals keep coming back to for everyday shopping rather than one that trades quietly.

The store serves local households buying groceries, pantry staples and fresh produce, the kind of weekly or top-up shop that keeps a neighbourhood supermarket busy day to day. It is part of the independently run Spar group found across South Africa, and this branch trades from 293 Marshall Street in Flora Park, Polokwane.

It suits residents of Flora Park and nearby areas who want a dependable, local option for groceries and fresh produce without a trip into Polokwane's bigger shopping centres.

Spec-Savers Polokwane CBD is an optometry practice trading from the Checkers Centre on Hans van Rensburg Street, in the heart of Polokwane's CBD. The branch operates under the Spec-Savers banner, built around affordable eyecare, and the brand's own booking page confirms that eye tests can be reserved online rather than relying only on a walk-in visit.

Patients visiting the branch are seen by optometrists and optical staff for eye examinations, general optometric services, and a range of eyewear and frames to suit different budgets and prescriptions. Being able to book ahead means a visit can be planned around work or school hours rather than waiting to be seen on the day.

Trading from the CBD rather than one of Polokwane's malls, the branch is a convenient stop for shoppers and workers already in the city centre who need an eye test or new glasses without travelling further out.

Unicare Hospital is a hospital in Polokwane Central, operating from premises on Burger Street in the Hospital Park area close to the city centre. As with any hospital, it provides facilities for patients who need inpatient care, treatment and monitoring beyond what a single consulting room can offer, rather than functioning as a stand-alone clinic or GP practice.

Online reviews of the hospital describe it in general terms as a tidy, well-kept facility, and more than one visitor has referred to it as being among the nearest hospitals serving the Polokwane area, which points to regular local use by patients and their families.

Based at 71 Burger Street, Polokwane Central, Unicare Hospital serves patients in Polokwane and the surrounding area who require hospital-level care, and their visiting family members.

Silver Exclusive Lodge is a lodge offering accommodation in Dalmada on the edge of Polokwane, graded as a four-star property. Guest reviews collected on booking platforms describe it generally as well-reviewed, pointing to a consistent standard of accommodation rather than a single good write-up.

Guests check in from 14:00 and check out by 10:00, and the lodge takes both individual travellers and group bookings, making it suited to overnight stopovers as well as longer multi-night stays in the Polokwane area.

The lodge is based at 52 Fifth Avenue, Dalmada, Polokwane, and suits travellers wanting a well-reviewed, comfortable base on the edge of the city rather than lodging in the busiest parts of central Polokwane.
